title: Apple's HomeView Ships With Six-Month-Old Software
description: Apple's HomeView smart home hub has a 7-inch display and Siri AI, and can recognize faces to switch from a shared household screen to a personal profile. MacRumors reports that it ships with software that is about six months old.

title: OpenAI to bring AI models to Google's cloud, in further expansion beyond Microsoft
description: OpenAI will make its models available to developers through Google's cloud. This reportedly puts its models on all three major U.S. clouds, extending its distribution beyond Microsoft.

title: AWS, Anthropic race to deploy army of specialized engineers key to proving AI spending will pay off
description: AWS and Anthropic are training specialized forward-deployed engineers to help enterprises put AI into production. Anthropic is putting $100 million into a program to train 10,000 such engineers by the end of 2027.
